description.value: Oddfish Restaurant is a seafood-focused dining destination in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood that builds two menus each day around what arrives fresh from seasonal and local suppliers. The kitchen specialises in pescatarian and vegetarian cuisine, from succulent prawns to inventive cuts of fish, with both a rotating seasonal menu of signature dishes and a fully daily-contingent features menu. Pick-up, delivery, sit-down dining, and group bookings are all available.
